title: How to Configure Alert Thresholds
content: Step-by-step guide to configuring alert thresholds. Step 1: Navigate to Alerts → Rules in the main sidebar. Step 2: Click 'Create Rule' or select an existing rule to edit. Step 3: Define the metric query (e.g., system.cpu.user). Step 4: Set the evaluation window (e.g., average over 5 minutes). Step 5: Configure the critical and warning thresholds. Step 6: Choose the notification channel (email, Slack, webhook). Click Save. Note: CPU thresholds should typically be set above 85% for sustained periods of 5 minutes or more to avoid transient spikes triggering false alert notifications. You can also configure dead-man alerts to trigger when metrics stop arriving completely for a defined period.
